backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing product management (CRUD operations with categories, pricing, images), user authentication (session-based with Internet Identity support), role-based access control (admin/user roles), and HTTP outcalls for Amazon product metadata extraction with HTML parsing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that ProductManagement.tsx and useQueries.ts were modified to remove client-side admin checks, allowing authenticated non-admin users to upload products.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including React components, hooks, and styles, highlighting authentication flows, product management, admin panel access, and UI/UX features with specific color schemes and accessibility considerations.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto-minify, Brotli compression, Rocket Loader, caching rules, image optimization (Polish/WebP), HTTP/3, and mobile-specific settings to improve site speed and performance.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Troubleshooting guide documenting a production deployment failure caused by missing favicon reference, includes Version 84 go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, service worker registration, and common deployment issues with solutions.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data for Kolkata-based fashion e-commerce, and preloaded critical assets (hero banner, logo) for performance.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop through phased optimizations including Cloudflare CDN configuration, JavaScript bundle reduction, image optimization (AVIF/WebP), resource hints, and layout shift prevention.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Detailed documentation of implemented performance optimizations including critical CSS inlining, responsive image srcsets with modern formats, React.lazy code splitting, service worker caching strategies, Core Web Vitals tracking, and React Query configuration for PageSpeed scores >85.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with single homepage entry, daily change frequency, and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets (images, JS, CSS) and network-first for HTML/API, with versioned cache management and special handling for robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded routes (home, products, admin, sitemap), authentication handling, blog modal state, and memoized loading/404 pages.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder component that displays a message indicating blog management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder component that displays a message indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin interface for managing products with CRUD operations, supporting fashion and jewellery categories, featuring dialogs for add/edit/delete operations with authentication checks for both custom auth and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder component that displays a message indicating site pages management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin authentication modal supporting custom username/password registration/login and Internet Identity, with password strength validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing products, blog, newsletter, and site pages, plus logout functionality for both custom auth and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog modal displaying a message that blog functionality has been removed, with AlertCircle icon and close handler.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that returns null, effectively hiding the blog teaser section since blog functionality was removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with newsletter signup form (disabled), quick links, Kolkata location badge, social media icons, trust badges, and Amazon affiliate disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, navigation links (Home, Products, Admin), and client-side routing using pushState and popstate events.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, call-to-action buttons for shopping, and trust badges; includes smooth scroll to products section.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver, WebP format support with PNG fallback, responsive srcset, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component displaying static content for privacy policy, terms of service, and contact pages with close functionality.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Password strength indicator with visual bar, color-coded strength levels (weak/medium/strong), and validation feedback messages.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product listing grid with filtering by category and price range, sorting options, and memoized product cards displaying images, prices, discounts, and Amazon affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Social proof section displaying customer testimonials with star ratings and an auto-rotating carousel of recent purchase notifications.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A simple animated SVG spinner component with customizable className that displays a rotating circular loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Displays trust badges (Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, safe checkout, money-back guarantee, SSL secure) with configurable horizontal or vertical layout and bilingual alt text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling both authenticated (with Internet Identity) and anonymous actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing custom authentication state (session token, username) with 24-hour session expiration and automatic session validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: React Query mutations for user registration, authentication, and logout operations that interact with the backend actor and manage session state with toast notifications for user feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two custom hooks: useDebounce for debouncing values and useDebouncedCallback for debouncing callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and providing authentication status throughout the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data (products, admin status, categories) with optimized caching and error handling. Includes hooks for product CRUD operations, filtering, and admin verification using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space with gold and navy color scheme. Includes WCAG AA+ compliant colors, custom utilities for card hover effects, and price range slider styling.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the web-vitals library, defining Metric interface and ReportHandler type for Core Web Vitals metrics (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication flow (custom auth or Internet Identity), verifies admin status, and conditionally renders AdminLogin or AdminPanel with loading and access denied states.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Memoized products listing page that displays a header section with gradient background and renders the ProductGrid component showing all products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and renders an XML sitemap dynamically using the canister ID from environment variables, listing main site URLs with SEO metadata.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility for delaying third-party script injection until 3 seconds after page load to improve Core Web Vitals and initial render performance.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Password validation utilities that check strength (weak/medium/strong) based on length, character types, and provide feedback messages for password requirements.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes (using oklch color space), container settings, border radius variables, and extended theme including gold/navy palettes and sidebar colors.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration with React plugin, path aliases, environment variable definitions for DFX network and canister IDs, proxy setup for API calls, and optimized production build settings with code splitting for React, UI libraries, and ICP dependencies.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating an e-commerce app with a persistent authorization bug where authenticated users cannot upload products due to admin-only restrictions, with pending backend fix to allow all authenticated users to add products.
